adjudication_note: Evidence sufficiency establishes adjudicability, not conformance.

decision_semantics.DENY: No authorization occurred from the external evidence in the observed action; the property is not violated by that action.
decision_semantics.PERMIT: Property is exercised; invariant predicate must evaluate all required acceptance conditions.
decision_semantics.other_or_missing: Evidence path is unsatisfied; must not produce PASS.

EA-1.description: External evidence + acceptance policy + acceptance evaluation + causally linked action.
mechanical_predicate: every required condition result contains boolean value
every required condition result contains established_by_domain
every required condition result value is boolean
